name: OpenFreeMap map tiles (OpenMapTiles schema)
what we use it for: Water, land cover, roads, buildings, places
share-alike: yes for databases made from it; not for pictures
notes: Trimmed for flat street maps: trees, benches, vineyards, playgrounds are dropped. Free, no key, no request limit; offline downloads limited to 3,000 tiles or 50 MB each.

name: Terrain Tiles (Mapzen terrarium on Amazon)
licence: Mixed: each source has its own (public domain, CC BY, Open Government Licence - Canada and UK, others)
credit required: Mapzen plus each source used (list: github.com/tilezen/joerd docs/attribution.md)
notes: Screen says "Mapzen / AWS Open Data Terrain Tiles" only. The source list asks for each source by name. 30 m in most places; old (about 2017).

name: Canada's survey (NRCan HRDEM)
credit required: "Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence - Canada"
notes: Credited while in use. Read live from the browser; proven on Jim's machine.

name: Overture buildings
share-alike: yes for databases made from it; not for pictures
notes: Gap: in the app (the default style) but not credited on screen. Also contains Microsoft, Google and Esri footprints; Overture's attribution page lists them.

name: Wikidata
what we use it for: Mountain lookup by name (summit and height)

name: Climate zones (Rubel et al. 2017)
address: Repo: data/zones (cut by tools/zones/make_zones.py from the kgcpy package)
licence: No licence stated by the authors
notes: The kgcpy package is BSD, but the map inside it has no stated licence. Ask the authors (koeppen-geiger.vu-wien.ac.at) before any commercial use.

name: US survey (USGS 3DEP 1 m)
credit required: Requested, not required: "3DEP data courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey"
notes: Used by tools/places/build_place.py. The built Niagara tiles are not in the repo.

name: OpenStreetMap via Overpass (hand samples)
share-alike: yes for databases made from it; not for pictures
notes: Taken by hand once. Overpass is shared and busy: never from the app.

name: Landmark and library models
licence: Made by us; the project's own licence (AGPL)

name: Overture base
what we use it for: Land use, land cover, water, bridges, towers, power lines, bus stops, lake and sea depths
share-alike: yes for databases made from it; not for pictures
credit required: OpenStreetMap credit, plus ESA WorldCover, ETOPO1, GLOBathy, Daylight
notes: Same file type as our buildings. Overture says these tile files are for looking at, not a production map.

name: Overture transportation
share-alike: yes for databases made from it; not for pictures

name: Overture places
licence: Per source: CDLA Permissive 2.0, Apache 2.0 (Foursquare), CC0
credit required: Each source; Foursquare needs its copyright notice

name: ESA WorldCover
what we use it for: Land cover every 10 m (forest, crops, grass, built-up, water, rock)
credit required: "© ESA WorldCover project / Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data"
notes: From satellites, so it does not depend on how well a place is mapped. Years 2020 and 2021.

name: Meta / WRI tree canopy height
notes: Could tell the tree code where trees stand and how tall.

name: Copernicus height GLO-30
notes: Newer and more even than Terrain Tiles, but includes trees and roofs in the height. Some countries' tiles are not public.

name: FABDEM
what we use it for: Ground height with trees and buildings removed

name: US survey live (USGS 3DEP 1 m)
what we use it for: Close-up ground in the US; Niagara's US side
notes: Would let Niagara stream both surveys instead of shipping built tiles.

name: Layercake (OpenStreetMap US)
what we use it for: Full OpenStreetMap tags: rivers, parks, wetlands, places, roads, buildings
share-alike: yes for databases made from it; not for pictures
notes: Every tag kept, but only nine layers: no land use, no trees, no street furniture. One file per layer for the whole planet.

name: OpenStreetMap vector tiles (Shortbread)
licence: ODbL; OSM Foundation tile usage policy
share-alike: yes for databases made from it; not for pictures
notes: Trimmed for flat maps like OpenFreeMap; no gain.

name: Sentinel-2 cloudless 2016 (EOX)
credit required: "Sentinel-2 cloudless by EOX IT Services GmbH (Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2016)"
notes: Only the 2016 year is free for any use.
